Top candidates based on symptoms: Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot (sclerotia in stem, bleached), Southern_Blight (stem base, sclerotia), Alternaria_Black_Molds_Stem_Cankers.

Excellent match. This Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot reference (Bugwood_5593844) is from the same series as the test image (Bugwood_5593851) — same black plastic mulch background, same bleached white stem with dark sclerotia. Very strong match.

Let me check the second Sclerotinia stem reference to confirm.

This is a perfect match. The reference shows a stem split longitudinally with large grayish-black sclerotia embedded in bleached white pith — exactly what the test image shows. This is clearly Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot.

I still need to use all 8 views across at least 8 different classes. Let me continue.

Gray Mold shows a tan-brown stem lesion with rings — no sclerotia or white internal pith. Does not match.
Phytophthora Blight shows dark blackened stems with collapse — does not match.
Bacterial Wilt shows bacterial streaming test in water — completely different from test image.

Rhizopus Soft Rots shows microscopic view — completely different.
